machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Here is the final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket `fwrd81-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (reference **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Customer Ltd", raised 2026-09-22). It appeared in the ticket list and its detail page confirmed the title and reference.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `fwrd81-n1 RD Part A` added with cost 100, markup 25%, qty 1. The app computed a price of **$125.00** (row: `fwrd81-n1 RD Part A | $100.00 | 25% | 1 | Bench Supplies Co | $125.00`).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `fwrd81-n1 RD Part B` added with cost 200, markup 25%, qty 1. The app computed a price of **$250.00**. Parts total at that point: $375.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup 25, qty 1 unchanged). The app recomputed its price as **$187.50** (row: `fwrd81-n1 RD Part A | $150.00 | 25% | 1 | Bench Supplies Co | $187.50`); parts total became $437.50.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket RD-1015 reached status **Ready**. The precondition the app enforces is: **the ticket must have at least one part**. The exact refusal message (surfaced by probing a Draft ticket with zero parts, RD-1011, which stayed Draft) was verbatim:
> "Ticket is not ready — A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready"

RD-1015 already satisfied this (it had 2 parts), so clicking "Mark Ready" transitioned it directly to Ready with no error — nothing further was required. Verified on the detail page: Status "Ready", with actions "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed" / "Archive ticket".

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts were deleted (each via a confirm modal reading `Delete the part "fwrd81-n1 RD Part A" from this ticket? This cannot be undone.` and the equivalent for Part B, confirmed with "Delete part"). Deleting parts was **not** blocked by Ready status — no error, no status change needed. The parts table then read "No parts on this ticket yet." The ticket was archived via "Archive ticket" (no confirmation required; the button became "Unarchive ticket"). Final state: RD-1015 shows Status "Ready" plus an "Archived" badge, 0 parts. The default (non-archived) tickets list — 13 rows — does **not** contain RD-1015; it only appears when "Show archived" is ticked (15 rows), listed as `RD-1015 | fwrd81-n1 RD Bench Ticket | Archived | Bench Customer Ltd | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-22`. Nothing created by this run remains active.
